content.heroSubhead: A premium, disciplined, clean and professional fitness environment in Kurla West, Mumbai. Built for those who respect the iron and show up every single day.
content.aboutTitle: BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO TAKE FITNESS SERIOUSLY.
content.aboutParagraph1: At Sarveshwar Fitness, we have eliminated the distractions of commercial gym chains to focus on what actually produces results: heavy, properly maintained equipment, clean air-conditioned floors, certified guidance, and an unmistakable culture of respect and grit.
content.aboutParagraph2: Located in Kurla West, our facility serves both competitive lifters and dedicated individuals striving for everyday athletic excellence. We enforce a clean, orderly gym etiquette so that every training session is uninterrupted and purposeful.

mentor.name: Shri Pravin Sakpal
mentor.bio: Guided by the principles of Maharashtra State Chhatrapati Award Winner Shri Pravin Sakpal. A legacy of genuine Indian bodybuilding excellence, clean sportsmanship, and relentless discipline infused into our training philosophy.

rules.title: TOWEL IS MANDATORY
rules.description: Wipe benches after use. Hygiene is a non-negotiable sign of respect.

rules.title: GOOD BEHAVIOUR IS ESSENTIAL
rules.description: Treat staff, trainers, and fellow lifters with dignity and respect.

rules.title: NO DISRUPTIVE CONDUCT
rules.description: Loud disturbance, inappropriate speech, and rowdy behaviour are not tolerated.

rules.title: RE-RACK ALL WEIGHTS
rules.description: Always return dumbbells, barbells, and plates to their designated holders.

rules.title: CLEAN INDOOR FOOTWEAR
rules.description: Training shoes must be clean before stepping onto the rubber workout floor.

rules.title: DEDICATED LADIES HOURS
rules.description: Every afternoon from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM is reserved exclusively for women.
